instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only shadow density. Set shadow density to: open readable shadow interiors, same key, same highlight cores. Change only the mass of the darks as a grade. Do not move the key. Do not add or remove fill as a lamp. Do not harden the key into a new window. Do not invent a new cast-shadow edge. Do not lift or crush the black floor as fog. Do not add haze, grain, softness, hue, time of day, or a genre.
